facts.fact: Benin's deck lists reference registers for people (citizens) among what Benin has, and cites Decree No. 2020-100 of 26 February 2020 implementing the National Registry of Natural Persons.

Benin's deck says the ANIP register is accessible by all key government platforms through the PNI (XROAD BJ), and that systems including the Public Services Portal, e-Tax and Insurance for the Poor are integrated with it.
